serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Rackspace Government Cloud (RGC) is purpose-built to help organizations achieve Assessment & Authorization faster and with cost savings of up to 70%. Whether you are a government agency, systems integrator, or independent software vendor, RGC is the foundation you need to rapidly deliver mission value via the cloud.

Rackspace Government Cloud (RGC) wraps VMware and AWS in a secure-by-design management platform to meet the compliance requirements for FedRAMP and DoD Cloud Computing SRG. Customer solutions will be deployed and managed in secured enclaves within US Rackspace datacenters and/or AWS East/West and GovCloud. Customers are provided with dedicated application stacks to maintain data security at the necessary levels. All this is backed by a 24x7x365 U.S. only support model that allows Rackspace to provide the highest levels of assurance and security to our government customers.

Benefits Include:
- 24/7/365 operations and system support providing a fully-managed cloud solution up to and including guest operating systems and networks
- Secure-by-design cloud environment with proactive support, continuous monitoring, and governance
- Fully redundant solutions, with backup, restore, and disaster recovery built-in
- Comprehensive system security services as standard, including enterprise-grade log aggregation, endpoint protection, file integrity monitoring, and host-based Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS) and Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS)
- Unique combination of automation, accredited tooling, and human expertise, enabling cyber and operational support
